ayahs.ar: إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوۡمِهِۦٓ أَنۡ أَنذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment
ayahs.e2: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”
ayahs.tr: Innaaa arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee an anzir qawmaka min qabli any yaatiyahum 'azaabun aleem

ayahs.ar: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّي لَكُمۡ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.en: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner
ayahs.e2: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning
ayahs.tr: Qaala yaa qawmi innee lakum nazeerum mubeen

ayahs.ar: أَنِ ٱعۡبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.en: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me
ayahs.e2: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me
ayahs.tr: Ani'udul laaha watta qoohu wa atee'oon

ayahs.ar: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلࣲ مُّسَمًّىۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُۚ لَوۡ كُنتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.en: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew
ayahs.e2: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”
ayahs.tr: Yaghfir lakum min zunoobikum wa yu'akhkhirkum ilaaa ajalim musammaa; innaa ajalal laahi izaa jaaa'a laa yu'akhkhar; law kuntum ta'lamoon

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِي لَيۡلࣰ ا وَنَهَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day
ayahs.e2: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night
ayahs.tr: Qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee lailanw wa naharaa

ayahs.ar: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِيٓ إِلَّا فِرَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: But my invitation increased them not except in flight
ayahs.e2: but my calls only made them run farther away
ayahs.tr: Falam yazid hum du'aaa 'eee illaa firaaraa

ayahs.ar: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوٓاْ أَصَٰبِعَهُمۡ فِيٓ ءَاذَانِهِمۡ وَٱسۡتَغۡشَوۡاْ ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ ٱسۡتِكۡبَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance
ayahs.e2: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly
ayahs.tr: Wa inee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'alooo asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim wastaghshaw siyaabahum wa asaarroo wastakbarus tikbaaraa

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Then I invited them publicly
ayahs.e2: Then I certainly called them openly
ayahs.tr: Summa innee da'aw tuhum jihaara

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّيٓ أَعۡلَنتُ لَهُمۡ وَأَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ إِسۡرَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
ayahs.e2: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately
ayahs.tr: Summaa inneee a'lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israaraa

ayahs.ar: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver
ayahs.e2: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving
ayahs.tr: Faqultus taghfiroo Rabakam innahoo kaana Ghaffaaraa

ayahs.ar: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
ayahs.e2: He will shower you with abundant rain
ayahs.tr: Yursilis samaaa'a 'alaikum midraaraa

ayahs.ar: وَيُمۡدِدۡكُم بِأَمۡوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجۡعَل لَّكُمۡ أَنۡهَٰرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers
ayahs.e2: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers
ayahs.tr: Wa yumdidkum bi am waalinw wa baneena wa yaj'al lakum Jannaatinw wa yaj'al lakum anhaaraa

ayahs.ar: مَّا لَكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
ayahs.e2: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah
ayahs.tr: Maa lakum laa tarjoona lillaahi waqaaraa

ayahs.ar: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ أَطۡوَارًا
ayahs.en: While He has created you in stages
ayahs.e2: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺
ayahs.tr: Wa qad khalaqakum at waaraa

ayahs.ar: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَٰتࣲ طِبَاقࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
ayahs.e2: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other
ayahs.tr: Alam taraw kaifa khalaqal laahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلۡقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورࣰ ا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp
ayahs.e2: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp
ayahs.tr: Wa ja'alal qamara feehinna nooranw wa ja'alash shamsa siraajaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ نَبَاتࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth
ayahs.e2: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant
ayahs.tr: Wallaahu ambatakum minal ardi nabaataa

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمۡ فِيهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ إِخۡرَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction
ayahs.e2: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺
ayahs.tr: Summa yu'eedukum feehaa wa ukhrijukum ikhraajaa

ayahs.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِسَاطࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
ayahs.e2: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you
ayahs.tr: Wallaahu ja'ala lakumul arda bisaataa

ayahs.ar: لِّتَسۡلُكُواْ مِنۡهَا سُبُلࣰ ا فِجَاجࣰ ا
ayahs.en: That you may follow therein roads of passage
ayahs.e2: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”
ayahs.tr: Litaslukoo minhaa subulan fijaajaa

ayahs.ar: قَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss
ayahs.e2: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss
ayahs.tr: Qaala Noohur Robbi innahum 'asawnee wattaba'oo mal lam yazid hu maaluhoo wa waladuhooo illaa khasaara

ayahs.ar: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكۡرࣰ ا كُبَّارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
ayahs.e2: and who have devised a tremendous plot
ayahs.tr: Wa makaroo makran kubbaaraa

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُواْ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدࣰّ ا وَلَا سُوَاعࣰ ا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسۡرࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr
ayahs.e2: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’
ayahs.tr: Wa qaaloo laa tazarunna aalihatakum wa laa tazarunna Waddanw wa laa Suwaa'anw wa laa Yaghoosa wa Ya'ooqa wa Nasraa

ayahs.ar: وَقَدۡ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيرࣰ اۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلࣰ ا
ayahs.en: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error
ayahs.e2: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”
ayahs.tr: Wa qad adalloo kasee ranw wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa

ayahs.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمۡ أُغۡرِقُواْ فَأُدۡخِلُواْ نَارࣰ ا فَلَمۡ يَجِدُواْ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers
ayahs.e2: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah
ayahs.tr: Mimmaa khateee' aatihim ughriqoo fa udkhiloo Naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonil laahi ansaaraa

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحࣱ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
ayahs.en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant
ayahs.e2: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth
ayahs.tr: Wa qaala Noohur Rabbi laa tazar 'alal ardi minal kaafireena daiyaaraa

ayahs.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓاْ إِلَّا فَاجِرࣰ ا كَفَّارࣰ ا
ayahs.en: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever
ayahs.e2: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers
ayahs.tr: Innaka in tazarhum yudil loo 'ibaadaka wa laa yalidooo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa

ayahs.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيۡتِيَ مُؤۡمِنࣰ ا وَلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارَۢا
ayahs.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction
ayahs.e2: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”
ayahs.tr: Rabbigh fir lee wa liwaa lidaiya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw wa lil mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa
